static_traits.name: Li Kaiwen
static_traits.social_status: Apart from a close friend who is about to move away, lacking a stable social support system
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; previously no psychotherapy/counseling experience
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, Low mood (sadness, Loneliness), high cooperation, able to Reflect but in a hesitant tone, steady pace

basic_info.main_problem: Continuously feeling pain and sadness because a close friend is about to move away for a new job, and believing I will no longer have friends nearby.
basic_info.core_demands: This news markedly affected his emotional health, and it is difficult to cope with the upcoming changes, so he seeks counseling to obtain help with coping and adjustment.
growth_experiences: During university, met a friend in a group project and kept in contact for a while, then gradually lost touch.

core_beliefs: I am not accepted by others

special_situations.event: Learned about a week ago that a close friend will move away due to a new job
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have no nearby friends, I will lose support and remain in Loneliness long-term
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-relying on this single relationship for security, immersed in imagining worst-case scenarios without taking action to expand social circles
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: After he leaves there will be no friends around me anymore.

special_situations.event: Thinking about situations of having no one to accompany me on weekends or evenings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no one spends leisure time with me, it means I have no friends and am not needed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding plans for social activities, staying at home and constantly rehearsing worst-case scenarios
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be alone all night; no one to talk to.

special_situations.event: Noticing my own personality trait of 'not being outgoing'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not outgoing, I cannot build new relationships
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labeling myself as 'unable to make friends', thereby giving up trying new interpersonal contact
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not outgoing; I simply cannot make new friends.

special_situations.event: Imagines whether others are willing to form a connection with oneself
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others usually will not want to connect with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Presetting rejection before trying, thereby reducing or avoiding contact
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Who would want to connect with me?

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to be accompanied and understood and to maintain a stable, intimate support relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected or abandoned, thereby falling into long-term Loneliness
defense_goal: Relying on a single close relationship for security
Avoiding new social attempts to reduce the risk of Being rejected

object_relations.self_representation: A not-outgoing-enough person who may Be rejected, a Lonely person
object_relations.object_representation: Others who may be cold or unwilling to connect with oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests exploring new social opportunities or setting specific small goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying that trying will only confirm 'no one wants to be friends with me', feeling I cannot do it
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'I am not outgoing / it is hard' in a cautious, hesitant tone, downplaying the need to try, avoiding explicitly committing to concrete action.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out my experience of successfully making friends in a university group project
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing positive experiences as not applicable now, thereby diminishing their meaning
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying past successes, negating their value with phrases like 'that was long ago / it does not count', in a flat tone.

manifestations: The close friend's move triggering worry about 'having no one to rely on'
Repeatedly imagining Being alone on weekends and nights, with no one to talk to
Social support system weak, mainly relying on a single friendship
outcomes: Social avoidance and slowness to act

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated Self-doubt (e.g., 'I am not outgoing' 'who would want to connect with me')
Hesitant toward trying new activities; emphasizes difficulties and risks
Limits actions by imagining worst outcomes

exception_events.target_problem: In situations requiring meeting new friends, usually avoiding trying due to Self-doubt and catastrophic predictions, thus continuously feeling Loneliness and lacking support.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During a university Group project, did not avoid unfamiliar contact as usual, but naturally built a friendship through collaboration, maintaining contact for a while.
exception_events.reason: Clues: shared tasks and goals provided a natural interaction context; different approach: frequent communication and collaboration during cooperation; environmental support: peer interaction reduced rejection risk and awkwardness.

positive_force: Experience of successfully building friendships in cooperative settings (university group projects)
Interested in new activities (has always wanted to try a cooking class)
Willing to seek professional help and express emotional needs
negative_force: Obvious tendencies of catastrophizing and predicting the future
Overgeneralization and mind-reading leading to low social Self-efficacy
Social support network is single, excessively relying on one friendship
Avoiding new interpersonal attempts, lacking specific strategies and channels

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (not actively seeking or participating in activities for Meeting new friends)
antecedent: Learning that a close friend is about to move away
Thinking about Being alone on weekends/evenings
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and predicting the future (worrying no one wants to connect with oneself) and Fear of Being rejected, leading to low social Self-efficacy.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the discomfort of Being rejected and embarrassment, reducing Anxiety in the short term.
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent Loneliness and sadness, hindered expansion of social network.

antecedent: Imagining life scenes after a close friend leaves
target_behavior.core_reason: Trying to gain a sense of control and psychological preparation by rehearsing the worst scenario.
target_behavior.function: Briefly providing the illusion of 'mental preparation', avoiding directly facing uncertainty.
target_behavior.consequence: Worsened Low mood, Decreased drive, attention occupied and affecting daily life.
